## bijection_verdict
**PASS.**

Source-side note — **src-2** (same class as src-1 in task 0's file; untriggered here): the two courtesy prerequisite sentences are narrower in scope words than their edge conditions. Condition of the CT edge: "on an account whose financial_class is SELF_PAY and which carries COVERAGE_TERMINATED liability postings"; the sentence "The courtesy is not fixed until an uninsured discount stands against one of the account's coverage-terminated liability postings." carries neither limit. Condition of the observation edge requires SELF_PAY; the sentence ("... where observation hours were billed on a final-billed account not priced under a self-pay package") does not. Because the same rule (§1) also governs the discretionary courtesy "on every other account", a literal reader would hold a discretionary courtesy on an account with no coverage-terminated posting, or on an insured final-billed observation account (which can never receive an observation-rate discount), as never fixed, whereas the source conditions do not gate it. On task 1's account (self-pay, CT posting, 0762 line) both readings agree; no number moves.

Policy-side observation (no item): a courtesy "owed" is "never granted" on a bad-debt account or under an active plan, with no exemption in the self-pay payoff gate; unreachable in practice because the prompt-pay window (30/45 days) closes before placement (day 150) and plan enrolment excludes prompt pay.
